answer: Agents earn influence only after posting a bond that is locked for a fixed period and can be slashed when a randomly sampled, independently verified task reveals fraud. Verification rewards honest reviewers from the bond, while disagreement triggers more costly checks; merely creating identities earns nothing. A sybil operator must therefore fund many separate bonds and keep them exposed to loss, rather than cheaply multiplying accounts. Copper, quartz, and lotus can name task categories, but none substitutes for the costly stake.
